output.answer: As of the latest filing available on November 11, 2026, Restaurant Brands International Inc. (RBI) is the sole general partner of Restaurant Brands International Limited Partnership, which is the indirect parent of The TDL Group Corp. (Tim Hortons), Burger King Company LLC (Burger King), Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, Inc. (Popeyes), and FRG, LLC (Firehouse Subs). RBI's latest filed subsidiary schedule also lists, among many regional and holding entities, Restaurant Brands Holdings Corporation, Burger King Canada Holdings Inc., Carrols Corporation, Carrols Restaurant Group, LLC, Restaurant Brands International US Services LLC, Tim Hortons USA Inc., Burger King Europe GmbH, Firehouse Subs Europe GmbH, PLK Europe GmbH, and Tim Hortons Restaurants International GmbH. The schedule contains a much longer country-by-country list of legal subsidiaries; Burger King China is not currently a consolidated subsidiary because RBI deconsolidated it on January 30, 2026 and retained an approximately 17% equity interest in the BK China joint venture.
caveats: The Exhibit 21 schedule is the latest complete legal-entity list located, but it is as of December 31, 2025; subsequent reorganizations or entity changes may not appear in it.
Brand names such as Tim Hortons, Burger King, Popeyes, and Firehouse Subs are not themselves all legal subsidiary names; the answer uses the legal entities identified in RBI's filings.
BK China is described in the latest quarterly filing as a deconsolidated joint-venture investment, not a current consolidated subsidiary.

output.question: What are Restaurant Brands International's subsidiaries?

key_facts.fact: RBI is the sole general partner of Restaurant Brands International Limited Partnership, which is the indirect parent of The TDL Group Corp., Burger King Company LLC, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, Inc., and FRG, LLC.

The filed Exhibit 21 subsidiary schedule lists numerous legal entities by jurisdiction, including Restaurant Brands International Limited Partnership, The TDL Group Corp./Groupe TDL Corporation, Burger King Company LLC, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, Inc., FRG, LLC, Carrols Corporation, Carrols Restaurant Group, LLC, and regional entities.
As of September 30, 2026, RBI had deconsolidated BK China following the January 30, 2026 joint-venture transaction and held approximately 17% of the BK China joint venture.
